name: Jaroslav Bžoch - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion on behalf of the European Union of the Agreement between the European Union and Bosnia and Herzegovina on the cooperation between the European Union Agency for Criminal Justice Cooperation (Eurojust) and the authorities of Bosnia and Herzegovina competent for judicial cooperation in criminal matters
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should sign a cooperation agreement with Bosnia and Herzegovina. The agreement lets Eurojust, the European Union agency that helps countries fight cross-border crime together, work directly with Bosnia and Herzegovina's authorities on criminal cases. It also allows them to share personal data, with safeguards for privacy. The aim is to investigate and prosecute serious crimes such as organised crime and terrorism more effectively. The Parliament gives its consent; the Council can now conclude the agreement.

- Eurojust and Bosnia and Herzegovina's judicial authorities can cooperate and exchange personal data on serious crimes.
- People in the European Union and Bosnia and Herzegovina gain from better cross-border crime investigations, with privacy safeguards.
- The Council can now formally conclude the agreement on the European Union's behalf.
